timing_evidence.mitigation: New probe waits for LE Connection Update Complete for its own handle and target timing before measuring

limitations: Echo probes do not establish game compatibility or gameplay quality.
Host FD prototype retains exported FD copies until single-session teardown; not suitable for production reconnect.
Current measurement has queue depth one; production burst/backpressure handling is not verified.
Role-switch discovery had one timeout; explicit legacy parameter preparation passed one later connection but needs repetition.
Wi-Fi power save is on during current BLE measurements; classic/TCP earlier controls disabled it.
Repeated role switching is now verified, but reverse-role p99 reached 397065us under changed game load; this is not a controlled latency comparison.
Window4 improves throughput, but 1024-byte fragmentation still had p50 210018us; throughput is not a frame-rate guarantee.

linux_protocol_tests.scope: Native ARM64 framing, ATT, timing, physical advertising proof, diagnostic FD, timed pipeline draining; before duplex worker addition.

discovery_repair.method: Read-only current HCI advertising proof; map the fresh GBA service to the matching BlueZ address and address type, without requiring stale cached GATT UUIDs. No device removal or bluetoothd reset.
discovery_repair.socket_repair: On Tina 4.9, writable plus SO_ERROR=0 is insufficient; require successful L2CAP_CONNINFO (BT_CONNECTED) before MTU/GATT requests.

pipeline_bootstrap.method: Serialize initial fragments and verify echoes plus complete CRC ACK before enabling the bounded window.
pipeline_bootstrap.root_cause: Asynchronous first AcquireWrite initialization is a plausible cause of initial burst loss; exact BlueZ buffer lifetime cause remains unproven.

core_regression.scope: Own worktree pinned Mac gpSP and existing protocol 3 TCP/relay/save/compatibility/RFU regressions; no physical Bluetooth gameplay.

duplex_worker.scope: Independent CRC-checked opaque message bursts in both directions. 300 x 104-byte messages for each role assignment and 100 x 1024-byte messages each direction passed. Protocol 3/core/ROM identity and RFU game traffic are not yet integrated.
duplex_worker.ordering: Use acquired packet FDs because godbus v5.2.0 dispatches method calls in separate goroutines (conn.go:435); direct D-Bus write callbacks can be processed in a different order. This is the inferred cause of reverse-role bootstrap ACK rejection; FD trials passed.
duplex_worker.disconnect: Device1 Connected=false closes only the matching owned peer endpoint; verified in all three passing FD trial logs. Remote-FD lifetime stays scoped to one helper process/session; no reuse across reconnect.
limitations: Independent peer-arrival measurements are not echo RTT and cannot establish game FPS.
1024-byte fragmented client arrival p50=160126us and maximum=397285us remains unsuitable evidence for fluid play.
Actual duplex 10-minute run, frontend IPC, nearby room list/menu, compatibility errors and user game validation remain pending.

previous_native_upload_attempt.reason: Stopped this task owned SSH upload after it remained blocked during the long radio test; no native extended-suite pass claimed. The prior 19 native tests remain verified.

advertising_timing_repair.observed: BlueZ/Linux4.9 old MGMT Add Advertising overwrote 100ms with 1280ms; LE Create Connection cancelled after about 2 seconds.
advertising_timing_repair.method: Use BlueZ MinInterval/MaxInterval=100ms and an old-kernel shim after this application registers the sole advertisement; skip timing changes if any device is connected. No unrelated advertisement, Bluetooth service, connection or scan filter is changed.

conclusion: All 400 TCP and 400 repeated classic Bluetooth exchanges passed integrity checks. Classic 104-byte p50 ~33.8ms vs TCP ~4.3ms; classic is not selected as production default. Initial connection abort remains an unresolved transient, not relabelled as success. BLE GATT is still unmeasured.
